# Outer differential corpus. Paths are relative to tests/testfiles/. x86/x64 PE
# (exe/dll/sys)
# and ELF (x86/x64) only -- .NET/Mono assemblies (no dnfile-equivalent
# backend in this project) and non-x86 ELF (aarch64, ARM, PA-RISC) are excluded;
# those backends have dedicated corpora.
#
# Stratified across format (PE32/PE32+/ELF32/ELF64), size (small/medium/
# large), and packed/unpacked (detected via UPX/ASPack/Themida/VMProtect
# section-name or marker-string signatures): every detected packed sample
# and every available ELF sample is included outright (both are scarce in
# this corpus); the much larger PE32/PE32+ pools are stratified by size
# bucket via an evenly strided sample within each bucket, proportioned to
# reach ~200 total.
